definitions.gloss: leisure; having time to spare; being at leisure
definitions.explanation: The state of having free time and not being occupied with work. Often implies wealth or social status that allows for a leisured lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}{夫人|ふじん}たちの{集|あつ}まり。
examples.english: A gathering of ladies of leisure.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}{階級|かいきゅう}のライフスタイル。
examples.english: The lifestyle of the leisure class.

examples.japanese: {有閑|ゆうかん}マダムたちが{高級|こうきゅう}レストランでランチを{楽|たの}しんでいる。
examples.english: Ladies of leisure are enjoying lunch at a high-end restaurant.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in compound forms rather than alone. {有閑|ゆうかん}{夫人|ふじん} and {有閑|ゆうかん}マダム both refer to wealthy women of leisure. {有閑|ゆうかん}{階級|かいきゅう} (leisure class) is a sociological term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有閑|ゆうかん}{夫人|ふじん} (lady of leisure)
- {有閑|ゆうかん}マダム (lady of leisure — more casual)
- {有閑|ゆうかん}{階級|かいきゅう} (leisure class)

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
{勇敢|ゆうかん} (brave) and {夕刊|ゆうかん} (evening newspaper) share the same reading.
